description: This file defines interfaces and structures for the IGstSrc component in the Rialto media server, including factory pattern, stream info structures, and method declarations for setting up GStreamer app sources.

classes.name: IGstSrcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving singleton instances of IGstSrc.

classes.name: StreamInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information about a media stream, including the app source element and DRM status.

classes.name: IGstSrc
classes.description: Interface for GStreamer source handling, including initialization and setup of app sources.

methods.name: setupAndAddAppArc
methods.description: Sets up and attaches an app source to the media pipeline.

methods.name: allAppSrcsAdded
methods.description: Notifies that all app sources have been added.
